name: transformation-builder
title_zh: 会先问你要原图还是缩略图的 ImageKit 变换链
tagline_zh: 写 ImageKit URL 时总记不住参数顺序？它把 resize、裁剪、AI 改图、抠背景排成链。
tagline_en: Never memorize parameter order again. It guides you through resize, crop, AI edits, background removal in chain.
desc_en: Guidance for building ImageKit image/video transformation URLs with the transformation_builder tool — how the tool works, how to write a good query, how to order multi-step chains, and a reference of every supported parameter. Use before calling transformation_builder. Covers resize/crop/focus, AI edits (change objects, colors, styles), background removal/replacement, generative fill, upscaling, r
why_zh: 不是参数速查表，而是按变换链顺序引导你构建 URL；能识别多步链的先后依赖，避免先裁剪后缩放的顺序错误。
why_en: It's not a cheat sheet but a step-by-step chain builder that enforces correct ordering of multi-step transformations, catching.
limit_zh: 只认 ImageKit 的变换参数，不覆盖其他图片服务；需要网络访问 ImageKit 文档，离线不可用。
limit_en: Only for ImageKit transformation URLs; requires internet for docs; outputs URL strings, not processed images.
title_en: ImageKit transformation chain builder that asks for source.
